name: Zeri
title: The Spark of Zaun
description: A mobile marksman. Aim Q for weapon fire; right-click to use her separate electric zap.

passive.name: Living Battery
passive.description: Moving and firing Q fill the battery. Right-click zaps for magic damage instead of firing bullets. A full battery empowers the zap with max-health damage; a low battery zap finishes targets below its execute threshold.

q.name: Burst Fire
q.description: Fires seven physical rounds. The burst rolls one crit and applies basic-attack procs once. Attack speed sets the cooldown; excess attack speed becomes attack damage.

w.name: Ultrashock Laser
w.description: Fires a slowing physical pulse. If terrain stops it, a wider laser fires from the wall after 0.85 seconds and critically strikes champions and monsters.

e.name: Spark Surge
e.description: Dash and reset your zap and Burst Fire timers. Dash into nearby terrain to ride across it. For 5 seconds Burst Fire pierces and deals bonus magic damage to its first target. Hitting a champion with a spell or charged zap reduces the cooldown.

r.name: Lightning Crash
r.description: Release a magic nova. Hitting a champion starts Overcharge: extra attack speed, movement speed, and Q chain lightning. Further champion hits extend Overcharge and build short-lived movement-speed stacks.
